lines.l: Fantasy could never be so killing, I feel free
I hope that you are willing, pick the beat up
And kick your feet up, dance with me
Let it lift you off the ground
Starry eyes and love is all around us
I can take you where you want to go
I want to be our partner, can't you see?
The music is just starting, night is calling
And I am falling, dance with me
